name: Denkiya
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood electronics/appliance shop (Mirai Denki): a closing-day change notice, a first day working part-time, a delivery-service guide, an online repair-request notice, a first-time-customer usage guide, a lesson in rephrasing technical words simply, teaching a junior how to check trade-in appliances, the shop's history of introducing a delivery-tracking app, a trade-in plan guide, a subscription-warranty trend column, a hybrid inspection-membership system guide, a reflection on balancing efficiency and peace of mind, and a one-year report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
